visual_action: A slideshow of two photos. The first is a screenshot of an Instagram post from Jill Biden's account (@drbiden) showing her and President Joe Biden dressed in formal wear on a city balcony at dusk. The post caption reads "Date night!". The second photo shows the Bidens inside a theater, with Joe Biden holding a Playbill for the play "Othello".
